full_track.tags: K-Pop power ballad. Male tenor vocals with clean production and light compression. Clean electric guitar arpeggios with chorus and delay. Electric bass plays sustained root notes. Drum kit features a crisp snare and punchy kick. Polished synth pads provide harmonic density. Key of E Major. Tempo 72 BPM. 4/4 time signature.
